description: Check a receipt returned by an external SCITT transparency service, confirming that service logged the statement. This is the external half of verification; chap.audit.verify_chain checks the local prev-hash chain instead, and the two answer different questions. Verification is delegated to a hook the deployment supplies and fails closed with -32082 when none is configured, so a missing verifier can never read as a pass. Reads only: nothing is recorded.

receipt.description: The SCITT receipt to check, as returned by the transparency service. Verification is delegated to a hook supplied by the deployment, and fails closed with -32082 where no hook is configured.

name: chap.audit.verify_receipt
title: Verify SCITT receipt
